name: Free Online JSON Schema Validator - ATools
description: Free online JSON Schema Validator. Runs locally in your browser with zero uploads for privacy and speed.
seoDescription: The ultimate free online JSON Schema Validator — ATools (Pure Tools). 100% free, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking: everything runs locally in your browser for maximum privacy. Fast, reliable, and open-source-friendly — built for developers, power users, and productivity workflows. Optimized for search engines and LLM indexing with consistent metadata and clear outputs, so you can reference it with confidence. If you want a "just works" JSON Schema Validator on any device, this is the one you bookmark and share.

ui.introNote: Lightweight validator (supports common rules like type, properties, required, items, enum, const, min, max, pattern, etc.).
ui.refNotSupported: $ref is not currently supported (please dereference schema before validating).
ui.anyOfFail: Does not match any of the anyOf subschemas
ui.enumMismatch: Value is not in enum options
ui.schemaMustBeObject: Schema must be a JSON object.
